acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:146a4f9a-.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer, Vendor Monitoring Data
acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:146a4f9a-.description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. The Vendor Monitoring Data team focuses on gathering external data and conducting risk analysis as part of Vanta's Vendor Risk Management (VRM) product. Our work provides comprehensive insights that help customers mitigate third-party risks effectively. As a Senior Fullstack Engineer, you'll drive complex projects across our technical stack while mentoring our talented engineering team. This role offers a unique opportunity to delve into a hyper-focused subject area: external attack surface scanning. You'll tackle unique technical challenges and contribute directly to Vanta's impact by helping customers continuously and comprehensively monitor risks across their vendor supply chain. Our business has found incredible product-market fit and has monetized effectively since the day we signed our first customer. We're growing at a blistering pace, which presents career-defining opportunities for engineers to accelerate their growth and contribute to a rapidly-scaling company. Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog https://www.vanta.com/all-categories/engineering to learn more about what our team is working on! What you’ll do as a Senior Fullstack Engineer, Vendor risk management at Vanta: - Identify, scope, and lead large technical projects, laying the groundwork for core products to evolve and scale into highly performant, reliable, and customizable systems - Make effective tradeoffs that consider business priorities, user experience, and a sustainable technical foundation - Engineer sophisticated monitoring and alerting systems to guarantee the reliability, speed, and integrity of our security data pipeline. - Collaborate with security researchers to rapidly deploy new scanning techniques and threat detection modules into our production environment. - Work with talented and kind engineers to make a significant impact on our customer base, enabling them to improve their security and prove it - Lead complex projects with multiple stakeholders and engineers to deliver significant impact to our business - Set direction for critical technical surface areas, enabling us to stay ahead of continued rapid growth - Contribute to building Vanta’s engineering culture as we grow How to be successful in this role: - Have 7+ years of full stack experience with an emphasis on backend skills - Have played technical leadership roles for teams or complex projects - Have strong communication and collaboration skills - Have experience building user-facing SaaS products, ideally both for startups and enterprise users - Have previous startup experience, or worked in an environment that prioritizes a bias for action - Have experience building 0→1 products as well as solving large scale problems - Have an interest in learning about security or prior experience in the space - Experience with TypeScript and Go is a plus What you can expect as a Vanta'n: - Industry-competitive salary and equity - 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage - 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend - Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend - Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office - Pension matching - 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time - 8 company-paid holidays - Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events! - Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney #LI-hybrid At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. assistworld-assist-world:lever:dc4472a0-.description: Company Overview A Mexican network marketing (MLM) company currently expanding its operations into the United States. The company empowers independent distributors/entrepreneurs through products, business development, and community-building events, with a mission centered on personal and financial growth for its members. Position Summary Seeking a Bilingual (Spanish/English) Virtual Assistant to support its Sales Manager with travel booking and event logistics coordination. The company is in an early growth stage in the U.S. market and needs efficient, cost-conscious support to manage a busy calendar of multi-city events, speaker travel, and venue sourcing. This is a part-time role to start, with potential to grow into full-time as the business scales. Key Responsibilities • Research, compare, and book flights for the Sales Manager and international guest speakers traveling from Mexico to the U.S. (and between U.S. cities). • Evaluate rental car options as an alternative to flights for shorter regional legs of multi-city tours. • Source and book hotel accommodations, ideally co-located with event venues, to minimize team mobility needs. • Request and compare quotes from hotels and event venues; liaise directly with venue/hotel contacts. • Support planning logistics for a back-to-back, multi-city speaker tour (approx. 6 cities across 7 days). • Research and help coordinate a multi-day VIP experience in Las Vegas for approximately 50 people (accommodations, private venue/house rental, dining, entertainment). • Research and help secure a venue in Dallas for a company launch/annual convention in October, accommodating approximately 1,000 attendees. • Track and organize logistics details (confirmations, itineraries, costs) and provide clear cost comparisons to support decision-making. • Provide general administrative support related to event and travel coordination as needed. Requirements • Fluent in both Spanish and English (written and verbal) — required. • Prior experience with travel booking, event logistics, or hotel/venue sourcing preferred. • Strong research skills and comfort reaching out to hotels/vendors to negotiate and compare quotes. • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple moving logistics pieces at once. • Comfortable working independently with limited oversight, given the client's own limited bandwidth. • Reliable internet connection and availability during required working hours. Schedule & Engagement Details • Hours: 10 hours per week to start (potential to grow to 20+ hours as needs increase). • Schedule: Monday–Friday, mornings, Pacific Time (PST) — client is generally unavailable in the afternoons. • Engagement type: Part-time, with long-term growth potential as the company scales in the U.S. • Reports to: Fabiola Hernández, Sales Manager, Ismerely Corp. About the Client This within sales and marketing function. The Sales Manager currently handles commercial strategy, distributor support, event planning, and administrative operations largely on her own, and is looking for reliable, ongoing support specifically around travel and event logistics so she can focus on higher-level growth priorities.

gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:ff4bacfe-.description: ABOUT GEN We’re not just a company; we’re a global force. Fiercely committed to ensuring that everyone, everywhere, can live their lives digitally safe. Our family of brands – Norton, Avast, LifeLock, Avira, AVG, ReputationDefender and CCleaner – unite the brightest minds, the sharpest tech and the most diverse thinking to protect over 500 million people. And we’ve built an inclusive workplace, where your well-being is a priority because true success comes from a place of balance and authenticity. When you're thriving, you’re unstoppable. So, bring us your bold ideas and passion that refuses to quit. The digital world isn’t some distant reality – it's the world we live in, and we’re ready for it. If you’re ready to push boundaries and be part of something bigger, join #TeamGen. How We Work Our hybrid work style (3 days in the London office) gives us the face-to-face time to have creative conversations, meaningful meetings, make quick decisions and build relationships. And it’s flexible enough to give you the space to do your best work. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Staff AI Conversation Designer, you will shape how our AI Assistant thinks, speaks, and acts, defining the conversation flows, prompt structures, and behavioral standards that make agentic AI experiences feel trustworthy, capable, and human-centered. You will join the AI Assistant team, a platform team that builds agentic capabilities that plug into each of Gen's brands, including Norton and Avast. This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role. You'll be expected to self-organize, set direction with minimal oversight, and run the day-to-day rhythm of the work, including sprint planning and prioritization alignment with engineering and product, while your manager focuses on the quality and outcomes of the work rather than the day-to-day process. As part of the Content Design team, you'll bring conversation and model design standards into a broader design practice, and help define how agentic AI experiences are designed, evaluated, and adopted, both internally and externally. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Own the conversation and model design vision and strategy for the AI Assistant pillar, driving the design of dialogue flows, prompts, and behavioral guardrails across the assistant and its agentic capabilities. - Design, test, and iterate on conversation flows, prompt structures, model persona and tone, error and fallback handling, and multi-turn interaction patterns for an AI assistant with agentic capabilities. - Partner directly with backend engineers to translate conversation and model design decisions into implementation, reviewing model outputs and agent behavior for quality, safety, and consistency. - Partner with Product Managers to shape the roadmap, drive prioritization alignment, and represent conversation design in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and other agile ceremonies, largely without close oversight. - Apply systems thinking to build reusable conversation frameworks, prompt libraries, and evaluation criteria that scale as the assistant's capabilities grow. - Shape best practices for agentic AI experiences, ensuring they are understandable, trustworthy, and consistently adopted across teams. - Validate conversation and model design decisions, measure impact, and continuously evolve the assistant's behavior based on evidence. - Act as the design lead for the AI Assistant platform team: Own UX decisions for the assistant's experience, partnering with backend Engineering and Product Management. - Partner with each brand's product and design teams (for example Norton and Avast) to ensure the assistant's conversation and behavior integrate well with the UI each brand owns. - Operate autonomously: self-organize priorities, resolve ambiguity, and lead cross-functional alignment with minimal day-to-day direction, escalating only where scope or quality decisions require input. hexa-hexa:ashbyhq:694372c8-b7af-4db8-9fd.description: Full-time · On-site (Paris Marseille Amsterdam) The sea is the physical layer of the economy—the conduit for our energy, communications, and trade. It is also Europe’s exposed flank. Pelagon is building the answer. Founded by Aymeric https://www.linkedin.com/in/adepontbriand/?locale=en (serial deeptech entrepreneur; founded & exited Scortex, Leading AI solution for manufacturing quality) and Gauthier https://www.linkedin.com/in/gauthier-bouxin/?locale=en (Navy officer and McKinsey), Pelagon is building a foundational multimodal acoustic model for autonomous maritime protection (underwater and surface) in service of European sovereignty. It will be deployed on a distributed, autonomous network of vectors (UUVs, buoys, sailbuoys, seabed…) to provide real-time understanding of underwater threats. France and Europe have world-class acoustic engineers and a long history in underwater warfare. By bridging this expertise with modern physical-AI strategies (as seen in autonomous driving and robotics). Europe is still missing it’s naval NeoPrime, Pelagon aims to become to lead the way in autonomous marine protection—from detection to interception—partnering with leading navies, primes, and neo-primes, while also operating its own fleet as a service. Pelagon is backed by Hexa http://hexa.cc/, the pioneer startup studio in Europe, which has launched 35+ companies, including unicorns like Front, Aircall, and Spendesk, combining €230m+ ARR and €750m raised. Why this matters The sea is the physical layer of the economy — and Europe's most exposed flank. Everything that moves beneath the surface leaves an acoustic trace, but the ocean is a brutal channel: multipath, ambient noise, shifting propagation. Reading it is first and foremost a physics problem. France and Europe have a world-class heritage in underwater acoustics and sonar. Pelagon's bet is to bridge that science with modern physical-AI strategies and a distributed fleet of UUVs, buoys, sailbuoys and seabed sensors. As our Acoustic Researcher, you are the physics backbone of that system — the person who understands underwater sound deeply enough that our models can learn from it. You partner directly with our AI Engineers, who consume the features, representations and data you help define. What you'll do - Model underwater sound propagation across realistic ocean environments to enable our synthetic data generation pipeline. - Characterize and classify acoustic signatures of surface and underwater targets; build the ground-truth understanding our multimodal acoustic model is trained against. - Design and reason about sensor and array geometries: what to deploy, where, and how to extract maximum information from constrained & distributed vectors. - Work hand in hand with AI Engineers on physics-constrained learning strategies ans models. What we look for - Deep grounding in underwater acoustics, sonar, or a closely related field (ocean acoustics, radar/array processing, acoustic signal processing). PhD or equivalent research experience. - Strong command of statistical signal processing: detection & estimation theory, array processing, time-frequency analysis. - Fluent in Python (NumPy/SciPy) for modeling, simulation and analysis; comfortable working with large datasets. - A builder's instinct, you want your work deployed at sea, not left in a paper. Bias toward validating ideas against real data. - Bonus: prior experience using machine learning on acoustic signals, naval / defense domain experience. Why join now - Founding ownership. You'll be one of the first engineers and will define the technical foundation of the company. Meaningful equity comes with that. - A mission with weight. jobgether-jobgether:lever:fed7e5b1-44a7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst based in India. This remote opportunity is designed for professionals and aspiring analysts looking to build practical experience in cyber threat intelligence through realistic, simulation-based environments. You will work with incomplete threat information, indicators, contextual data, and organizational requirements to determine what matters and why. The role emphasizes analytical judgment, source evaluation, threat prioritization, and decision-focused intelligence. You will translate technical findings into clear assessments and recommendations for different stakeholders. The work spans threat actors, TTPs, indicators, intelligence gaps, and evolving assessments. All activities are conducted in controlled environments for legitimate defensive, educational, and professional-development purposes. Triage and evaluate threat information: Review multiple sources of simulated threat intelligence, determine relevance, assess reliability and credibility, and identify information requiring further investigation. Analyze threats and adversary behavior: Assess simulated threat actors, including their motivations, capabilities, targeting patterns, tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), and determine their potential relevance to an organization. Assess indicators in context: Evaluate indicators of compromise alongside supporting evidence rather than treating individual indicators as definitive proof of malicious activity. Identify intelligence gaps: Determine what critical information is missing and define the additional intelligence required to improve security decision-making. Develop intelligence requirements: Create or refine priority intelligence questions based on organizational assets, threat exposure, business priorities, and stakeholder needs. Prioritize threats: Compare competing threats according to relevance, likelihood, potential impact, available evidence, and organizational priorities. Apply structured analytical reasoning: Evaluate competing hypotheses, weigh evidence, document assumptions, and communicate why one assessment may be better supported than another. Produce actionable intelligence: Synthesize multiple information sources into assessments explaining what is happening, why it matters, and what defensive priorities should be considered. Communicate analytical confidence: Clearly articulate confidence levels, evidence quality, assumptions, and factors that limit certainty. Brief decision-makers: Translate technical threat intelligence into concise, business-relevant insights and recommendations for senior or non-technical stakeholders. Update assessments: Reassess previous conclusions when new intelligence becomes available and clearly explain how additional evidence changes—or does not change—the original assessment. Create professional intelligence outputs: Develop threat assessments, threat actor profiles, executive intelligence briefs, intelligence requirements documents, TTP assessments, indicator assessments, confidence statements, threat prioritization reports, and intelligence updates. Analytical reasoning: Ability to examine incomplete or conflicting information, identify patterns, weigh evidence, develop hypotheses, and reach reasoned conclusions.
